description: Open update PRs from the 24th to the 28th of each month, a few days before the release on the 1st, and automerge the non-major ones once the CI Gate check passes

customManagers.description: Track the tip of jspecify/jdk main

Track the newest generally available Java major in jdkBuildVersion. The datasource returns versions such as 28.0.1+9; extractVersion keeps the major, so Renovate writes 28 when the next major ships and ignores 27.0.x updates.
Track the newest LTS Java major that runs Gradle

packageRules.description: An LTS release ships every two years: 21, 25, and every fourth major after them
Automerge non-major updates after the CI Gate check passes

Open a PR for a new Java major as soon as it reaches GA, so the next release carries its API, and automerge it: every job runs Gradle on java-lts, the build runs on jdkBuildVersion, and NullAway checks the stubs with its javac
Automerge major updates of the actions GitHub publishes; the workflow runs each of them on the PR
Leave updates of docker/gensrc.Dockerfile for review: CI builds without Docker, so a green CI Gate says nothing about the image
Group non-major updates of GitHub Actions into one PR
Group major updates of the actions GitHub publishes into one PR, apart from other majors: Renovate automerges a group only when every update in it automerges
